part: AO3400A 30 V N-channel MOSFET, SOT-23: the backlight current sinks' pass transistors
notes: Run in its linear region as a current regulator (not a switch). The simulation used Alpha & Omega's AO3400 subcircuit (the A version's model was not available); checked against this datasheet: Vth 1.08 V (datasheet 0.65-1.45, typ 1.05), RDS(on) 43 mOhm at 2.5 V (max 48), 26 mOhm at 4.5 V (max 32).

ratings.design: drain = LED cathode: at most VSYS 5.7 V (hot plug) less the LEDs' Vf
56 mA at 100% duty (113 mA for both)

ratings.limit: 1.4 W (TA 25 C, 1 in2 copper); RthJA 100-125 C/W steady
ratings.design: 61 mW per FET on a full cell, 89 mW on USB (VSYS 4.7 V), 145 mW in a 5.7 V transient: about +11 C on USB
op-amp output swings to 3.3 V: any threshold in range regulates; 100k pull-down holds it off with 3V3 off
